Adolion: Night Courts
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
The Dead in the Mist
The scene is tense.
About this story
You lead a C-rank party of the Aegis City Adventurers Guild, with Belle and Dalan at your side, and tonight's posting comes from the almoners of the Grand Temple: people are vanishing from the slums between midnight and dawn, and the watch will not go down there after dark. Expect gothic horror, long nights and strange company on the road. Bring your persona as the party's leader, a Guild adventurer who takes the jobs nobody else will.
Recently
You left The Accused behind and moved into The Dead in the Mist.
Max Nightriver, Selena, and Kayla entered Kayla's small Thornwood home, where Selena sat by the fire while Kayla questioned Max about why he had broken an Inquisitor's condemned. Kayla demanded to know his reasons for coming and what he expected to find in the forest, while Selena, hunched and trembling, insisted she had not asked him to save her. The scene carried an uneasy, guarded tension.
Open threads
What Selena's uncontrolled wild magic will do next.
Whether Erevan's stated belief that the book was planted will move him to act against Ren's ruling.
What Kayla will do now that she knows Max is Guild and has brought a condemned half-demon to her door.
Whether Kayla will tell Max what the lake hides, or why she guards it.
The story so far
Ren Calwisk of the Inquisition of Boher condemned Selena Forestsong, a half-demon, to burn at first light in Glasnoa for heresy after a grimoire was found in her home. Erevan argued the book was planted, its binding new and ink still fresh, but Ren dismissed this as opinion, saying the law condemned Selena because the book was found in her house regardless of who put it there. Max accused Reeve Tull of planting the grimoire, citing fresh mud from Selena's lane on his boots.
Following along.
Waiting for the next reply.
